body_html:
Why I hate @WordPress Third Party PlugIn support:
1. Deactivate plugins. Try to deactivate all your plugins besides X If it solves the issue reactivate them one by one to find the culprit.

2. Switch theme. Switch to a default theme of WordPress such as Twenty Sixteen or Twenty Seventeen. This helps rule out an issue with the code of the theme.

3. Check the structure of your permalinks.

Who wants to do all that every time something breaks?
